headline: Daily refined fuels briefing
overview: AI summarization was unavailable for this edition; stories below carry their original feed descriptions.

stories.title: US DOE to Award $99MM to Geothermal Innovation, Exploration Projects
stories.summary: 'Five projects will conduct field-scale enhanced geothermal systems tests to validate technologies under real-world conditions, while 16 additional projects will conduct exploration drilling'.

stories.title: Global Upstream M&A Activity Set to Exceed 2025 Total
stories.summary: Global upstream mergers and acquisitions activity is on course to exceed last year's $175 billion total, Rystad Energy announced.

stories.title: Public companies produce most U.S. crude oil and natural gas
stories.summary: Publicly traded companies represent a tiny share of the total number of companies producing crude oil and natural gas in the United States, but they make up a large share of U.S. production. In 2025, publicly traded comp

stories.title: EU SAF supply exceeds 2025 ReFuelEU aviation target
stories.summary: Aviation-fuel suppliers reported supplying 39.3 million metric tons of aviation fuel at EU airports in 2025, of which 1.1 million tons—or 2.8 percent—was SAF.

stories.title: Sen. Grassley receives awards for biofuels leadership
stories.summary: Sen. Grassley, R-Iowa, received two awards from two different trade groups in September recognizing his leadership in and contributions to effective ag and biofuel policy.

stories.title: Renewable diesel continues to drive cuts in California climate pollution
stories.summary: Transportation achieved the largest total decrease in the state driven by the rising use of renewable diesel and zero-emission vehicles.

stories.title: GCMD, Equinor partner to advance alternative fuel, carbon value chains
stories.summary: The organizations will leverage their complementary expertise to help address technical and operational gaps in scaling alternative marine fuels.

stories.title: Saudis in Process of Starting Vital Oil Pipeline
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia is in the early stages of starting up a key oil pipeline, people familiar with the matter said.

stories.title: China Gas Raises LNG Order from Venture Global to 2.5 MMtpa
stories.summary: Venture Global secured a new agreement to supply 0.5 million metric tons per annum of United State liquefied natural gas to China Gas for 20 years from 2030.

stories.title: McDermott Completes Refinancing
stories.summary: The Houston-based energy projects contractor raised $1.05 billion in share and debt instrument sale proceeds.

stories.title: Diplomacy Knocks Crude Lower, But Diesel Bulls Aren’t Done Yet

stories.title: Texas Upstream Employment Rises
stories.summary: Texas upstream employment rose in August, the Texas Independent Producers and Royalty Owners Association (TIPRO) highlighted.

stories.title: Norway Gas Output Down Month on Month
stories.summary: The decrease comes as another strike looms.

stories.title: USA Diesel Price Surges Again
stories.summary: U.S. diesel surged again over the last week, GasBuddy highlighted.
